title: 第448章 灵石该怎么花呢第447章 紫发紫眸紫色旗袍
slug: 九恶妃每日一问陛下驾崩了吗
lines: “对那个感兴趣？”
女人看了秦然一眼，一招手，便将柜台里的金属残片取了出来，扔进了秦然怀里。
“送你。”
脑海中，小云云的声音又跳了出来，带着几分急促与期待。
“小仙仙～她从不送人东西的，她一定对你有好感！”
“快拿下她！你可以少奋斗一万年！”
“她对你真的不一样！！”
“你认识她？”秦然问出了关键问题。
小云云沉默了一瞬，迅速掩盖了过去，“这不重要！笨蛋，这是你抱紧富婆大腿的绝佳机会！！”
旗袍女人似笑非笑的看着秦然。
那眼神让秦然一阵发毛。
之前在黄金家族的时候，小云云与他神识交流，故意没有去遮掩气息，为的就是让黄金虎心生忌惮。
而现在，云宫掠天术一直遮着二人的交流，按理说不该被发现才对，可这女人的笑容是几个意思？
“我要走了。”秦然硬着头皮道。
出乎意料，女人并没有拦他，反而笑眯眯的递给他一枚玉符。
“如果有事的话，可以随时捏碎。”
“好。”秦然收下。
女人朝他摆了摆手，神色揶揄，“那就……拜拜，哥哥！”
秦然眼皮一跳。
这鬼地方，他是一秒不敢多待了。
他迅速离开商会，又一刻不停的远离了这让他毛骨悚然的星月城……
望着秦然离去的背影。
女人的唇角勾起了一抹趣色。
“好久不见了，小云云。”
“见到姐姐，居然不出来打个招呼，以前白宠你了，小家伙倒是长得不错……”
秦然离开星月城后，直接捏碎传送玉符。
小云云坐在他的肩膀上，眼中带着促狭笑意，“小仙仙～好端端的，你跑这么快做什么？”
“关你屁事。”
“呦？”小云云勾唇，“你好凶哦～”
秦然黑着脸，“所以，刚才你在商会大堂里问我的那句话是故意的，对不对？”
“哪句？”小云云装傻。
“说她老那句！”
“哦，没错。”小云云展颜一笑。
秦然无语了。
他就知道，这世上没那么多巧合。
好在安然离开了，还白嫖了一堆好东西……
content_en:
"Interested in that?"
The woman glanced at Kieran, waved, took out the metal fragments from the counter, and threw them into Kieran's arms.
"Send it to you."
In my mind, Xiao Yunyun's voice jumped out again, with a bit of urgency and expectation.
"Xiao Xianxian~ She never gives anything away, she must have a good impression of you!"
"Get her quickly! You can save ten thousand years of struggle!"
"She really treats you differently!!"
"Do you know her?" Qin Ran asked the key question.
Xiao Yunyun was silent for a moment and quickly covered up the past, "It's not important! Idiot, this is the perfect opportunity for you to hug the rich woman's thigh!!"
The cheongsam woman looked at Qin Ran with a half-smile.
The look in his eyes made Qin Ran hairy.
When he was in the Golden Family, Xiao Yunyun deliberately did not conceal his aura when communicating with his spiritual consciousness, just to make Golden Tiger afraid.
And now, Yun Gong's sky-skimming technique has been covering up the communication between the two. Logically speaking, it should not be discovered, but what does this woman's smile mean?
"I'm leaving." Kieran said bravely.
Unexpectedly, the woman did not stop him, but instead handed him a jade talisman with a smile.
"If anything happens, you can crush it at any time."
"Okay." Qin Ran accepted.
The woman waved her hand towards him with a teasing expression, "Then...bye, brother!"
Kieran's eyelids twitched.
He didn't dare to stay in this damn place for a second longer.
He quickly left the Chamber of Commerce and stayed away from the Xingyue City that made his hair stand on end...
Looking at Qin Ran's leaving figure.
The corners of the woman's lips curled up with a hint of interest.
"Long time no see, Xiao Yunyun."
"When I saw my sister, I didn't come out to say hello. I spoiled you before for nothing. The little guy is actually pretty good..."
After Qin Ran left Xingyue City, he directly crushed the teleportation jade talisman.
Xiao Yunyun sat on his shoulder, with a narrow smile in her eyes, "Xiao Xianxian~ It's so good, why are you running so fast?"
"None of your business."
"Huh?" Xiao Yunyun raised her lips, "You are so fierce~"
Kieran's face was dark, "So, what you asked me in the Chamber of Commerce lobby just now was intentional, right?"
"Which sentence?" Xiao Yunyun pretended to be stupid.
"Say what she always said!"
"Oh, that's right." Xiao Yunyun smiled.
Qin Ran was speechless.
He knew that there weren't that many coincidences in the world.
Fortunately, An Ran left and got a bunch of good things for free...
